description: This file contains a set of unit tests for the Azure Queue Streaming utilities within the Orleans framework. It defines a test class 'AQSubscriptionMultiplicityTests' that verifies different subscription scenarios such as parallel, linear, add/remove, resubscription, deactivation, and client subscription tests. The class configures an Orleans test cluster with Azure Queue Stream providers and includes methods for setup and cleanup.

classes.name: AQSubscriptionMultiplicityTests
classes.description: A test class that verifies multiple subscription behaviors for Azure Queue streams in the Orleans framework.

classes.name: MyClientBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans client builder to use Azure Queue streams with specific options.

classes.name: MySiloBuilderConfigurator
classes.description: Configures the Orleans silo builder to include memory storage and Azure Queue streams.

methods.description: Sets up the test cluster with necessary configurators.

methods.description: Initializes the test runner after cluster setup.

methods.name: DisposeAsync
methods.description: Performs cleanup after tests, including deleting Azure queues.

methods.description: Tests multiple parallel subscriptions to the Azure Queue stream.
